_comment: Every SHARC_* and DIGI_* environment name that the Rust, TypeScript and Python sources mention as a string literal. owner: language and directory of the first mention. Checked by tools/devtools/env_registry.py (mise run check:env); names built at run time are in prefixes; not_env lists look-alikes that are not variables.

DIGI_ALLOW_STALE_GEN.purpose: 1 turns the refusal of a generated SHARC core older than sharc_core into a warning (flag)

DIGI_BIND_CLOSE_CF_CALL.purpose: Path to a prebuilt cf_call runner for the DSP sample binding close test (default pk_cfcall.EXAMPLE)

DIGI_BUDGET.purpose: Overrides the CPU budget of an Nx launcher run (positive integer)

DIGI_CARD_CACHE.purpose: Directory of shared content-named card images for device tests (default dist/session-cache/cards)

DIGI_CARD_IDENTITY.purpose: Selects the emulated card identity (a test sets small for a 1 MiB blank card)

DIGI_CATALOG_CARD.purpose: Path to a prebuilt DT2 card image for the file-catalog device proof

DIGI_CATALOG_EMUD.purpose: Absolute path to the prebuilt digi-emud daemon for the file-catalog device proof

DIGI_CFDIS.purpose: Path to the cfdis ColdFire disassembler binary (default: out/native/cfdis-tool, built on demand)

DIGI_CF_IPS.purpose: ColdFire emulated instructions per second (default 132000000); timers and SSI pacing follow it

DIGI_CF_MIX_OUT.purpose: Output directory: a cf-mix build of coupled-run writes one executed-instruction JSON per scenario

DIGI_CF_STATES.purpose: 0 disables the cached ColdFire boot-state snapshots in the patchkit boot harness (flag)

DIGI_COLD_RELAX_FS.purpose: Set (any value) relaxes the DT2 filesystem check that the readiness wait expects on a used card

DIGI_CONFORM_DEVICE.purpose: Device (dt2 or dn2) that the machine conformance tests run on

DIGI_CONFORM_MODULES.purpose: Comma-separated module ids (author/name) that the conformance tests select

DIGI_COUPLED_DSP_EXPORT.purpose: Output file path: the pinned coupled ready workload test writes the DSP export there

DIGI_COUPLED_FEATURES.purpose: Cargo features of the coupled-run build (default coupled-audio)

DIGI_COUPLED_FIXTURES.purpose: Directory of the DN2 ready fixtures (snapshots) for coupled runs and the desktop app

DIGI_COUPLED_PCM_F32LE.purpose: Output file path: the coupled ready workload test writes its PCM as f32 little-endian there

DIGI_COUPLED_SYX.purpose: Path of the DN2 firmware .syx for coupled runs (fallback after DIGI_EMU_SYX)

DIGI_DDR_MONITOR_EMUD.purpose: Absolute path to the digi-emud daemon for the DSP DDR monitor device test

DIGI_DDR_PROOF_CF_STATE.purpose: Optional ColdFire state snapshot path for the DDR proof CF tests

DIGI_DESKTOP_TRIG1_HOLD.purpose: Instructions that Trig 1 is held in the desktop Trig 1 capture test (default 40000000)

DIGI_DESKTOP_TRIG1_PCM_F32LE.purpose: Output file path: the desktop Trig 1 capture test writes its PCM as f32 little-endian

DIGI_DESKTOP_TRIG1_PRESS_AFTER.purpose: Instructions to wait before Trig 1 is pressed in the desktop Trig 1 capture test (default 0)

DIGI_DESKTOP_TRIG1_REQUIRE_NONZERO.purpose: 1 makes the desktop Trig 1 capture test fail on silent PCM; 0 or unset allows it

DIGI_DEVICES_DIR.purpose: Directory of the devices/*.toml device profiles, read at run time (else devices/ found from cwd)

DIGI_DIAG_DIR.purpose: Default directory for diagnostic output files whose own *_OUT variable is unset

DIGI_DSPI_LOG.purpose: Output file path: the DSP peer logs every DSPI2 frame the ColdFire sends (DSPILOG1 binary)

DIGI_DSP_MODEL_LOG.purpose: Output file path: per-frame DSP tier counters as CSV

DIGI_DSP_PEEK_EMUD.purpose: Absolute path to the digi-emud daemon for the DSP cache registers device test

DIGI_DSP_PERIOD.purpose: DSP instructions per DSPI2 frame; experiment override of the coupled DSP scheduling

DIGI_DSP_RX_PHASE.purpose: DSP instructions (below the period) of SPI delivery phase inside a frame; experiment only

DIGI_DSP_WATCH.purpose: Comma-separated DSP word addresses sampled once per frame into the watch CSV

DIGI_DSP_WATCH_OUT.purpose: Output CSV path for DIGI_DSP_WATCH (frame, pc, busy, watched words)

DIGI_DT2_CARD.purpose: Set makes coupled.py use the DT2 one-sample card and its ready state (same as --dt2-card)

DIGI_DTCN0.purpose: bus turns on the DTCN0 bus-clock timer model, off turns it off (default on for DN2, off for DT2)

DIGI_EMUD.purpose: Path to the digi-emud daemon binary used by the stock and device tests (shared by both devices)

DIGI_EMUD_DN2.purpose: Path to the DN2 digi-emud daemon binary; overrides DIGI_EMUD for DN2

DIGI_EMUD_DT2.purpose: Path to the DT2 digi-emud daemon binary; overrides DIGI_EMUD for DT2

DIGI_EMU_CF_SNAPSHOT.purpose: Path of the ColdFire ready snapshot (default READY/digi-audio-m5.snap)

DIGI_EMU_DSP_IMAGE.purpose: Path of the DN2 DSP image (default READY/digi-audio-dn2-image.bin)

DIGI_EMU_DSP_STATE.purpose: Path of the DSP ready state (default READY/digi-audio-m5.snap.dsp)

DIGI_DEVICE.purpose: dt2 or dn2 runs a device test file for that device only (unset: both); Nx sets it for the --dt2 and --dn2 halves

DIGI_EMU_FAST.purpose: 0 turns off the SHARC fast regions (no region list is added)

DIGI_EMU_PANEL.purpose: 1 forces a rebuild of the desktop panel (otherwise rebuilt only when its sources change)

DIGI_EMU_PCM_F32LE.purpose: Output file path: the desktop emulator captures its audio as f32 little-endian PCM

DIGI_EMU_PCM_SECONDS.purpose: Seconds of PCM to capture for DIGI_EMU_PCM_F32LE (unset means unlimited)

DIGI_EMU_PGO.purpose: 0 turns off PGO in gate and launcher builds (flag)

DIGI_EMU_PGO_TRAIN.purpose: 1 retrains a stale or missing PGO profile when the launcher starts (flag)

DIGI_EMU_PGO_VARIANT.purpose: Name of the PGO build target directory for experiments (default pgo-use, which the launcher owns)

DIGI_EMU_READY_DIR.purpose: Directory of the DN2 ready inputs (overrides ready_dir in tools/emulator/ready_inputs.json)

DIGI_EMU_SECOND_CORE.purpose: 1 enables, 0 disables the second device core in the desktop launcher (default on for desktop)

DIGI_EMU_SINK_WAV.purpose: Output WAV path: the audio that the output device actually played, as float WAV

DIGI_EMU_SYX.purpose: Path of the Digitone II firmware .syx for the emulator launcher

DIGI_EMU_SYX_DT2.purpose: Path of the DT2 firmware .syx for the emulator launcher

DIGI_FILES_CARD_DT2.purpose: Path to the prebuilt DT2 card image for the files API device test

DIGI_FILES_EMUD_DN2.purpose: Path to the prebuilt DN2 digi-emud daemon for the files API device test

DIGI_FILES_EMUD_DT2.purpose: Path to the prebuilt DT2 digi-emud daemon for the files API device test

DIGI_FILES_PATCH_DN2.purpose: Path to the patched DN2 firmware for the files API device test

DIGI_FILES_PATCH_DT2.purpose: Path to the patched DT2 firmware for the files API device test

DIGI_FILES_PLAN_DN2.purpose: Path to the DN2 patch plan (plan.json) for the files API device test

DIGI_FILES_PLAN_DT2.purpose: Path to the DT2 patch plan (plan.json) for the files API device test

DIGI_FIRMWARE_DIR.purpose: Directory of the stock firmware images (default firmware/)

DIGI_FLUSH_CHECK.purpose: 1 turns on the emulator cache-flush check; patchkit proof runs set it with DIGI_WRITE_WATCH

DIGI_FW_EMU_SOCKET.purpose: Control socket path of the emulator for the web Firmware page test; set by os_upgrade_rig.py

DIGI_INTC_FORCE.purpose: Set to 0 to turn off delivery of guest-forced interrupt sources (INTFRCH/INTFRCL); on by default (A/B).

DIGI_JOBS.purpose: Bounds the number of parallel render jobs (integer); not part of the render cache key.

DIGI_KEEP_TEST_DIR.purpose: When set, the card export and roundtrip Rust tests keep their temporary directory (flag).

DIGI_LEGACY_SNAPSHOT_DN2_SYX.purpose: Path to the exact stock DN2 image for the legacy snapshot policy test; the test skips if unset.

DIGI_LEGACY_SNAPSHOT_DT2_SYX.purpose: Path to the exact stock DT2 image for the legacy snapshot policy test; the test skips if unset.

DIGI_LIVE_SOCKET.purpose: Daemon socket path that the desktop live preview Vite server connects to (set by pk_panel.py).

DIGI_LP0_AUDIO.purpose: Set to 1 to run the optional held stock audio case of the LP0 sample transfer device test.

DIGI_LP0_BOOT_FIXTURE.purpose: Absolute path to the private provenance JSON of the boot fixture for the LP0 sample transfer test.

DIGI_LP0_CF_CALL.purpose: Path to the ColdFire call runner used by the LP0 proof test (default pk_cfcall.EXAMPLE).

DIGI_LP0_CLOSE.purpose: Set to 1 to run the optional native held stock audio CLOSE case of the LP0 sample transfer test.

DIGI_LP0_EMUD.purpose: Path to the emulator daemon binary used by the LP0 sample transfer device test.

DIGI_LP0_FULL_BANK.purpose: Set to 1 to run the optional full sample bank case of the LP0 sample transfer test.

DIGI_LP0_LOG.purpose: When set, the emulator prints a stderr line for each LP0 unit it handles (tag, words, rearm count).

DIGI_LP0_VOICES.purpose: Set to 1 to run the optional voices case of the LP0 sample transfer device test (otherwise skipped).

DIGI_NO_PROGRESS_MS.purpose: Wall-time limit in ms of the no-progress watchdog in device tests (default 120000; 0 turns it off).

DIGI_PANEL_TX_LOG.purpose: File path; the emulator appends one line per front-panel UART8 drain and per injected panel button.

DIGI_PATCHED_CACHE_MAX_GB.purpose: Size cap in GB of the patched boot-pair cache; the patchkit harness removes the oldest entries above it (default 30).

DIGI_PATCHED_STARTUP_EMUD.purpose: Path to the emulator daemon binary used by the patched DSP startup device test.

DIGI_PATCHKIT.purpose: Path to the patchkit binary for host and device tests (default dist/patchkit/patchkit).

DIGI_PATCHKIT_BIN.purpose: Path to the patchkit binary used by the patched DSP startup and stereo proof device tests.

DIGI_PGO_DETAIL.purpose: Detail text of the PGO profile state, set by native_emu.py for the child and read by the desktop app.

DIGI_PGO_STATUS.purpose: PGO profile state (such as stale), set by native_emu.py for the child and read by the desktop app.

DIGI_PK_PGO.purpose: Set to 0 to run the patchkit harness on a non-PGO emulator binary (pk_load.py defaults it to 0).

DIGI_PK_READY_DN2_112.purpose: Directory of the ready inputs for DN2 OS 1.12 used by patchkit proofs and module checks.

DIGI_PK_READY_DT2_117.purpose: Directory of the ready inputs for DT2 OS 1.17 used by patchkit proofs and module checks.

DIGI_PK_ROOT.purpose: Repository or module variant root passed to patchkit as --root in device tests (default repo root).

DIGI_PLUSDRIVE.purpose: Path to the plusdrive CLI binary used by device tests (default the shared build).

DIGI_PLUSDRIVE_OUT.purpose: Directory for card exports and backups of the control daemon (default out/plusdrive).

DIGI_PLUS_DRIVE.purpose: Root of the plus_drive device folders for the control daemon (default the repository's plus_drive/).

DIGI_READ_WATCH.purpose: Hex guest ranges LO-HI or LO+LEN; logs CPU loads from them with the PC and per-byte load counts (read-watch instrument).

DIGI_RENDER_CACHE.purpose: Set to 0 to turn off the render cache of tools/devtools/render_cache.py.

DIGI_RENDER_CACHE_CHECK.purpose: unclear: cache control, not a render input; see tools/devtools/render_cache.py:44

DIGI_RENDER_CACHE_MAX_GB.purpose: Size limit of the render cache in GB (default 30).

DIGI_REPO_ROOT.purpose: Repository root that the runtime patcher uses to find the module library.

DIGI_REQUIRE_PGO.purpose: Set to 1 to make a stale or missing PGO profile a fatal error in native_pgo.py.

DIGI_RUNTIME_MODULES.purpose: Directory of the built runtime modules installed by device tests (default dist/modules).

DIGI_SNAPSHOT_DIR.purpose: Directory of the daemon's boot snapshots (default: <run dir>/patched, private to the run dir); device tests set one store per daemon build and device.

DIGI_SPIKE_LOG.purpose: Directory; when set, the emulator writes dsp.jsonl and cf.jsonl timing logs for real-time spike analysis.

DIGI_STACK_WATCH.purpose: Hex ranges LO-HI of task stacks; records the lowest store address (stack high-water mark) per range.

DIGI_STACK_WATCH_EPOCH.purpose: Hex ranges LO-HI; a store into one ends a stack epoch, and the stack low-water mark is kept per epoch.

DIGI_STALL_MS.purpose: Emulated-time ms without progress before the health watchdog reports a stall (default 1000; 0 disables).

DIGI_STEREO_PROOF_EMUD.purpose: Path to the emulator daemon binary used by the DSP stereo proof device test.

DIGI_STORAGE_FAULT_EMUD.purpose: Path to the emulator daemon binary used by the storage fault device test.

DIGI_STORAGE_FAULT_ISR_DN2_SYX.purpose: Path to the stock DN2 image for the storage fault ISR patchkit Rust test.

DIGI_STORAGE_FAULT_ISR_SYX.purpose: Path to the stock DT2 image for the storage fault ISR patchkit Rust test.

DIGI_WRITE_WATCH.purpose: Hex guest ranges LO-HI or LO+LEN; logs every CPU and DMA write into them (write-watch instrument).

DIGI_WRITE_WATCH_AFTER.purpose: Start of write-watch reporting: cacr (first cache enable) or an instruction count (default from start).

DIGI_WRITE_WATCH_ALLOW_PC.purpose: Hex PC ranges LO-HI whose stores the write-watch does not report (the runtime's own code).

DIGI_WRITE_WATCH_LIMIT.purpose: Maximum number of write-watch events written to the log (default 100000); counting continues.

DIGI_WRITE_WATCH_OUT.purpose: Path of the write-watch JSONL log (default $DIGI_DIAG_DIR/writewatch.jsonl, else stderr).

DIGI_WRITE_WATCH_SEQ.purpose: Set to 1 to write one numbered write-watch log and summary per emulator of the process.

SHARC_AOT.purpose: Set to 0 to turn off the generated SHARC block tier (on by default).

SHARC_AOT_DENY.purpose: Comma list of hex entry PCs of generated SHARC blocks to leave out, for bisecting a tier fault.

SHARC_BLOCKTRANS.purpose: Hex PC list (or @FILE) of block-translator cluster roots for the first SHARC core.

SHARC_BLOCKTRANS_2.purpose: Same as SHARC_BLOCKTRANS for the second SHARC core.

SHARC_CIRC_NOWRAP.purpose: When set in a circstats build, circular-buffer post-modify returns the plain sum without wrap (diagnostic).

SHARC_CIRC_STATS.purpose: When set in a circstats build, prints circular-buffer post-modify counts to stderr at exit.

SHARC_CODE_LOG.purpose: When set, logs the differing PCs and barred entries of the SHARC code check to stderr.

SHARC_CODE_PARITY.purpose: When set, logs once how many SHARC PCs differ between the loaded code and the generated image.

SHARC_CONCRETISE.purpose: unclear: only a prefix filter, no reader; see tools/sharc_dev/blocktrans_coverage.py:586

SHARC_CYCMIX.purpose: Set to 1 to record the executed-instruction profile and cache hit rates for cycle costing.

SHARC_CYCMIX_MEM.purpose: Path of the per-PC instruction info file (size, branch, DAG registers) for the cycle-mix recorder.

SHARC_CYCMIX_OUT.purpose: Output path of the cycle-mix recorder (default cycmix.tsv in the diagnostic dir).

SHARC_FAST_AUTO.purpose: Run-time fast region selection, comma list of numbers a,b,... (mise run wb defaults it to 4,2,0).

SHARC_FAST_BACKEND.purpose: Path of a plug-in backend library for the SHARC fast tier; else the reference interpreter runs.

SHARC_FAST_CHAIN.purpose: Set to 0 to turn off chaining of fast-tier entries (A/B control; entries reached by a chain are then missed).

SHARC_FAST_CHASE.purpose: Fast tier: after a refused entry runs in the interpreter, the next instruction becomes an entry; 0 turns it off.

SHARC_FAST_CL_DISASM.purpose: Set: the Cranelift fast backend keeps and dumps the disassembly of each compiled kernel.

SHARC_FAST_CL_NOVERIFY.purpose: Set: the Cranelift fast backend skips IR verification of compiled kernels.

SHARC_FAST_CL_OPT.purpose: Cranelift opt level of fast-tier kernels: speed, speed_and_size (default none).

SHARC_FAST_COV.purpose: Set: fast-tier coverage reporting (why calls were declined, exits) at exit.

SHARC_FAST_DEFER.purpose: Number of calls to interpret before a new fast kernel is used; simulates a late background compile.

SHARC_FAST_DUMP.purpose: Directory: dumps fast-tier kernels and real calls (wasm gate input); needs the fast-dump feature.

SHARC_FAST_DUMP_ALL.purpose: Set: SHARC_FAST_DUMP also dumps kernels below the minimum instruction count.

SHARC_FAST_DYNFLAT.purpose: Set: instructions whose guarded dynamic window keeps failing at run time are lowered as flat accesses.

SHARC_FAST_FALLBACK_REGIONS.purpose: Fast roots used only when code verification bars their generated entry; hex list; DT2 1.17 default 0x1c2607.

SHARC_FAST_FALLBACK_REGIONS_2.purpose: Same as SHARC_FAST_FALLBACK_REGIONS, for the second SHARC core.

SHARC_FAST_FLATAUTO.purpose: Fast-tier flat-access lowering for auto-selected regions; on by default, 0 turns it off.

SHARC_FAST_FOLLOW.purpose: 1: extra fast-tier entries follow the stop instruction of a region (never dropped as unprofitable).

SHARC_FAST_GEN.purpose: Generated lowering forms for the fast tier: default all, 0 = hand-written forms only, or a comma list.

SHARC_FAST_GUARDED_READS.purpose: Set: fast-tier loads also go through a guarded dynamic window, not only clusters.

SHARC_FAST_HELPER.purpose: 1 or LO-HI hex ranges: instructions lacking an address range become helper calls instead of ending a region.

SHARC_FAST_HIST.purpose: Set: fast-tier run prints an interpreter histogram (instructions run outside the fast tier).

SHARC_FAST_LOG.purpose: Set: prints fast-tier summary and why calls were declined (wrong shape, refusals).

SHARC_FAST_NOBACKOFF.purpose: Set: turns off the fast-tier back-off after window declines (A/B control).

SHARC_FAST_NOGUARD.purpose: Set: turns off guarded dynamic windows for memory access in every fast region (A/B control).

SHARC_FAST_NOPUSHDYN.purpose: Set: pushes use static windows only, not the guarded dynamic window lowering (A/B control).

SHARC_FAST_NOREGN.purpose: Set: loops with register trip counts stay unknown in the fast tier (A/B control).

SHARC_FAST_ONLY.purpose: List of regions: restricts the fast tier to these entries (used by delta-debugging in fast_ddmin.py).

SHARC_FAST_REGIONS.purpose: Fast-tier region entry PCs (hex list; @FILE allowed) for the first SHARC core.

SHARC_FAST_REGIONS_2.purpose: Same as SHARC_FAST_REGIONS, for the second SHARC core.

SHARC_FAST_SHAPE.purpose: cfg: forces the control-flow-graph lowering shape for fast-tier regions.

SHARC_FAST_TIME.purpose: Non-empty, not 0: measures host ticks per fast region and reports them at exit.

SHARC_FAST_TL.purpose: Set: prints why each fast kernel is built and whether its machine code is position independent.

SHARC_FAST_TL_DUMP.purpose: Directory: dumps pointer-free fast kernels (measurement for the wasm backend).

SHARC_FAST_TL_X.purpose: unclear: see tests/devtools/test_render_cache.py:52 (only a sample env key in a test)

SHARC_GEN_DIR.purpose: Directory of the generated SHARC core (first core); read by sharc-gen build.rs.

SHARC_GEN_DIR_2.purpose: Directory of the generated SHARC core for the second core (sharc-gen-2).

SHARC_IRQ_PROBE.purpose: LO-HI[,..]:MASK[:EVERY]: latches interrupt bits at instruction boundaries in PC windows (diagnostic).

SHARC_LIVE_AOT_CAPTURE_DIR.purpose: Directory for raw generated-block call snapshots (opt-in diagnostic).

SHARC_LIVE_AOT_CAPTURE_PC.purpose: Hex PC of the generated block whose calls are captured.

SHARC_NATIVE_ALLOW_STALE.purpose: 1: load a stale native SHARC library anyway, with a warning (e.g. to time an old build).

SHARC_NATIVE_GUARD_LIB.purpose: Path of the native SHARC library used by the guard tests (default library if unset).

SHARC_NATIVE_LIB.purpose: Path of the native SHARC library; overrides the default build.

SHARC_PCDUMP.purpose: Comma list of PCs: dumps registers and stack depths at those PCs to a CSV; 0 records only stack maxima.

SHARC_PCDUMP_ICOUNT.purpose: lo:hi instruction-count window in which SHARC_PCDUMP records.

SHARC_PCDUMP_MEM.purpose: hexaddr:count: also dumps these memory words at each SHARC_PCDUMP row.

SHARC_PCDUMP_OUT.purpose: Output path of the SHARC_PCDUMP CSV (default pcdump.csv in the diagnostics dir; {pid} allowed).

SHARC_PROFILE_PREFIX.purpose: Path prefix: the SHARC engine writes its profile to files with this prefix when dropped.

SHARC_REGIONBENCH_SOL.purpose: Path of a local firmware-derived source file compiled into the region bench (build-time).

SHARC_REGIONBENCH_SOL_PATH.purpose: Set by sharc build.rs from SHARC_REGIONBENCH_SOL; the region bench includes this file.

SHARC_RENDER_CARD_SHA256.purpose: Expected card SHA-256 checked by the rendered replay test.

SHARC_RENDER_FRAMES.purpose: Max frame count for the rendered replay test.

SHARC_RENDER_INPUTS.purpose: Path of the input file for the rendered replay test.

SHARC_RENDER_LIB.purpose: Path of the native library for the rendered replay test.

SHARC_RENDER_PACK.purpose: Path of the SHARC state pack for the rendered replay test.

SHARC_RENDER_WIRE.purpose: Path of the expected ColdFire wire trace for the rendered replay test.

SHARC_REPLY_INFLIGHT.purpose: 1 reports, fail also halts: finds core stores into the SPI2 reply record while it is on the wire.

SHARC_REPLY_INFLIGHT_IPS.purpose: DSP instructions per second for the reply-inflight window (default 1500 x DIGI_DSP_PERIOD).

SHARC_REPLY_INFLIGHT_LOG.purpose: Number of reply-record changes printed one by one (default 24).

SHARC_REPLY_INFLIGHT_OUT.purpose: Output path of the reply-inflight summary (default reply-inflight.txt in the diagnostics dir).

SHARC_REPLY_INFLIGHT_SCK.purpose: SPI2 clock in Hz for the reply-inflight window (default 44000000).

SHARC_REPLY_INFLIGHT_SKIP.purpose: Number of first SPI2 exchanges that the reply-inflight check leaves out.

SHARC_REPLY_INFLIGHT_WORDS.purpose: Comma list of 32-bit word indexes of the reply record to count; others are ignored.

SHARC_TIER_TIME.purpose: Set to 1 to report host time per SHARC tier and per thread in audio.report (dsp_tiers.tier_time); also turns link timing on.

SHARC_UNINIT.purpose: Hex seed: reads of never-written DSP bytes return a seeded non-zero pattern instead of zero.

SHARC_UNINIT_LOG.purpose: File path: log of uninitialised-read patterns and trap hits (stderr if unset for the trap).

SHARC_UNINIT_TRAP.purpose: Non-0: lists reads of never-written DSP bytes once per word address; values unchanged.

SHARC_WWATCH.purpose: addr[:n],..: logs changes of watched DSP memory words (hex byte addresses) to a CSV.

SHARC_WWATCH_OUT.purpose: Output path of the SHARC_WWATCH CSV (default wwatch.csv in the diagnostics dir).

DIGI_EMU_RESERVE.purpose: Cores that stay idle for the rest of the machine when emu-slot admits an emulator (default: the efficiency cores, else a quarter of the cores, at least 2).

DIGI_EMU_SLOTS.purpose: Fixed number of machine-wide emulator slots, with no idle-core check (default: the ceiling from cores and RAM).

DIGI_TRANSFER_DIR.purpose: Folder for the packed .dkm files and the failed-pack record of dktransfer (default out/patch/transfer); a test run sets one inside its run directory.

prefixes.DIGI_EMU_READY_DIR_: Prefix: suffix is the device name in upper case (DT2): ready-input directory of that device
prefixes.DIGI_EMU_SYX_: Prefix: suffix is the device name in upper case (DT2): firmware .syx path of that device
prefixes.SHARC_FAST_: Prefix: every SHARC_FAST_* variable (fast tier setting) is passed on or filtered by native_pgo.py.

not_env.SHARC_DIR: Not an environment variable: Python constant for out/sharcdb in tools/coldfire/fw.py:42, patched in tests.
not_env.SHARC_VISA: unclear: see tests/coldfire/test_ghidraq.py:226 (a Ghidra address space name, not an environment variable)
